history.content: Hi, my phone has no service at all—no bars, no internet, and I can't send a picture message. Can you help me fix this?

I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing no service on your phone. Let's try to resolve this together. To assist you better, could you please provide your phone number or account details? This will help me check your line status and identify any issues on your account.

In the meantime, here are a few quick steps you can try:
1. Restart your phone.
2. Make sure Airplane Mode is turned off.
3. Check if your SIM card is properly inserted.

Once you provide your phone number or account details, I can check for any network or account-related issues on our end.
My phone number is +1-617-555-0148. I’m at home in Boston. What should I try first?

Your phone line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service, can't access the internet, or send picture messages.

Would you like me to resume (reactivate) your line now? Once reactivated, your service should return to normal within a few minutes. If you know why your line was suspended or if you have any questions, please let me know!
I didn't realize my line was suspended. Yes, please go ahead and reactivate my line so I can get service back.

It appears I cannot reactivate your line because your contract ended on 2024-11-30. This is why your line is suspended and cannot be resumed automatically.

To restore your service, you may need to renew your contract or select a new plan. Would you like information on renewing your contract or choosing a new plan? If you prefer, I can connect you with a human agent to assist you further. Let me know how you’d like to proceed!
